home.title: Hôtel Lynx — your base in Agadir · 2-star hotel in Talborjt
home.description: Clean rooms, a 24-hour reception, free Wi-Fi and free public parking by the door. A 2-star city hotel in Talborjt, opposite the Mohammed V Mosque. 8.4 on Booking.com.

hero.lead: Clean rooms, a reception that never closes, free Wi-Fi and free parking by the door. Right in Talborjt, opposite the Mohammed V Mosque.
hero.alt: The front of Hôtel Lynx in Talborjt: a three-storey pink building with wrought-iron balconies, a row of flags and the black HOTEL LYNX sign above the entrance.

basics.intro: We’re a two-star city hotel and happy with it. Here’s the whole deal before you book — no small print later.

yes.d: Guests score our cleanliness 8.9 on Booking.com.
Rated 9.5 by guests. Use it all you like.
Public spaces right by the hotel.
Someone at the desk, day and night.
Shower, toilet and towels in every room.
Over the roofs of Talborjt, facing the Kasbah hill.

no.d: We don’t serve it. Talborjt does — the first cafés are three minutes from the door.
Stairs only. Heavy bags? Ask at the desk for a hand.
The beach promenade is 23 minutes on foot, about 4 by taxi.

basics.img_alt: The reception of Hôtel Lynx: a lit wooden desk, carved chairs, a marble floor and the staircase with blue-tiled steps.
basics.img_cap: Reception and the tiled stairs. The desk is staffed round the clock.

rooms.intro: Every room has air-conditioning, its own shower room, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi. All non-smoking, all up the stairs.

single.name: Single
single.alt: A shower room at Hôtel Lynx: wall basin, mirror, towels on a rail and an open walk-in shower.
single.cap: Shower room — the Single, Superior Single and Twin share this layout.

superior.name: Superior Single
superior.beds: 1 single bed, or a large double bed when one is free
superior.line: One guest, a little more room.
superior.alt: A room at Hôtel Lynx with a large double bed, carved wooden wardrobe and a window onto the street flags.

twin.name: Twin
twin.alt: Twin room at Hôtel Lynx: two single beds with white linen, grey curtains, a wall-mounted TV and air-conditioning unit.

double.name: Double
double.line: For two. Some have a balcony — ask.
double.alt: Double room at Hôtel Lynx: a large double bed, a table and chair, and the glass door open onto a wrought-iron balcony.

triple.name: Triple
triple.alt: Triple room at Hôtel Lynx: a single bed and a large double bed, table and chairs, grey curtains and a wall TV.

notes: Many rooms have a small balcony. Ask for one when you write.
Prices move with the dates. Ask us for today’s price.

agadir.intro: Talborjt is the town centre Agadir rebuilt after the 1960 earthquake: grills, cafés, banks, the big mosque. Every time below is measured on foot from our front door.
agadir.img_alt: The rooftop terrace of Hôtel Lynx at sunset: white wrought-iron chairs, the minaret of the Mohammed V Mosque on the left and the Kasbah hill on the right.
agadir.img_cap: From our roof: the Mohammed V minaret, Talborjt, and the Kasbah hill.
agadir.arrow_note: Arrows point the way as the crow flies.
agadir.ride_h: Or hop in a petit taxi
agadir.ride_note: Petits taxis pass all day. Times are by road, traffic permitting.

arrive.p1: Check-in runs from 12:00 to 22:00, check-out by 12:00. Landing later? Tell us your arrival time when you write — reception is staffed 24 hours.
arrive.p2: Driving? Park for free in the public spaces right by the hotel. Coming from Al Massira airport, it’s about 24 km — ask us about booking you a taxi.
arrive.img_alt: Hôtel Lynx at blue hour seen from across the street: the lit HOTEL LYNX rooftop sign, street lamps and cars parked in front.
arrive.img_cap: Blue hour on Rue Al Mahdi Ibn Toumart. The lit sign on the roof is us.

lead_quote.q: Friendly, Central, Clean and Simple Hotel

quotes.q: Convenient location. Great staff. We are returning guests. First visit was 19 years ago.
So clean. I had a fantastic stay. The hotels can be a gamble in Morocco, and this one was excellent.
Smooth and easy check in, all nice staff no matter which time of the day, clean room and room service, clean linen and towels , hot shower and good water pressure.

ask.intro: Tell us your dates and we’ll reply with what’s free and today’s price. This form doesn’t book or charge anything: it writes a clear email to our reception, ready for you to send.

f.message_ph: Late arrival, a lower floor, questions…

done.p: Your email app should now be open with the message filled in. Press send and it goes straight to our reception.
